Rules.InvariantScript:
Set(emergencyAge, RandBetween(18, 80));
Set(emergencyGender, Index(["Male", "Female"], RandBetween(1, 2)).Value);
Set(medicalCondition, Index(
    [
        "None reported",
        "I fell and broke my ankle",
        "Chest pain",
        "Difficulty breathing",
        "Feeling dizzy and weak",
        "Possible allergic reaction",
        "Bleeding from arm",
        "Severe headache",
        "Sprained knee",
        "Unconscious person reported",
        "Panic attack",
        "Burn injury"
    ],
    RandBetween(1, 12)
).Value);
Set(emergencyLocation, Index(
    [
        "Ascot Avenue, Zetland",
        "George Street, Sydney CBD",
        "City Road, Camperdown",
        "Parramatta Road, Glebe",
        "King Street, Newtown",
        "Oxford Street, Darlinghurst",
        "Cleveland Street, Redfern",
        "Harris Street, Pyrmont",
        "Anzac Parade, Kensington",
        "Bourke Street, Surry Hills"
    ],
    RandBetween(1, 10)
).Value);
Set(emergencyDistance, Round(RandBetween(1, 30) / 10, 1));
Set(reportedSeconds, RandBetween(10, 120));
Set(emergencyType, Index(
    [
        "Medical emergency",
        "Injury",
        "Fainting",
        "Breathing difficulty",
        "Security threat",
        "Lost person",
        "Fire alert"
    ],
    RandBetween(1, 7)
).Value);

Set(waitingForNextEmergency, false);
Set(showEmergencyPopup, true)

ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
"Reported:                                                                                             " &
If(
    reportedSeconds < 60,
    reportedSeconds & " seconds ago",
    RoundDown(reportedSeconds / 60, 0) & " minute ago"
)
